title: Could the mall world be connected to the NDE wheel?
content: This is kinda a out there theory, but hey reality may surprise you at times. So for those of you that don't know, there's a very famous NDE [Wilson](https://www.nderf.org/Experiences/1wilson_fde.html) where he sees a infinite wheel made of infinite worlds that sorts him and gets put back in place in a world where the car accident never happened. And there are some members of the r/NDEWheel sub that also dream of the mallworld. I get bored sometmes and reddit stalk people. It's a habit lol. And I personally have a pre birth memory of something very similar to the wheel, and I've had mallworld dreams so maybe there is something in it. But it got me wondering, I wonder whether the mall world could be connected to the wheel. Perhaps it's a training ground so we could more easily pick lives in the wheel.. If we can master the mallworld, then maybe we can master the wheel. Just a thought
